# TDI Builders, Inc.

> 24/7 restoration services in Sacramento, CA.

TDI Builders, Inc. (TDI Builders, Inc.) is a professional restoration contractor serving Sacramento, CA and surrounding areas since 1985. We provide 24/7 emergency response for water, fire, mold, storm, biohazard, and reconstruction services. Phone: (877) 688-0866 · Email: .
